<b>Pious Isamor</b> is an [[NPCs (Silksong)|NPC]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It is a large rusted statue found abandoned deep within the [[Whispering Vaults]].

== Background ==
Pious Isamor is a large metal statue of a pilgrim,<ref>Inspecting Pious Isamor: <i>"A rusted statue of a pilgrim."</i></ref> which originally served to greet those who had newly arrived at [[the Citadel]] and to motivate them to join [[the Choir]].<ref name = stone>Pious Isamor restored dialogue: <i>"Hark! {{Red|P}}ilgrim! You {{Red|who}} climb{{Red|ed to}} our eternal embrace... who stand stru{{Red|ggling/struck at}} the threshold {{Red|of}} our stark Citadel of stone... kno{{Red|w that/your}} true service may now commence.<br>Forget... your weary shell. Forgo {{Red|the}} urge to still... {{Red|Ph}}arloom commands... give {{Red|the}} greatest gift! Join our chor{{Red|us}}... Raise {{Red|your}} shell... {{Red|your}} voice... and sing!"</i></ref> Its dialogue implies that it dates back to a time when the [[Weavers]] had already bequeathed the Citadel to the [[Conductors]], but before it became gilded, opulent, and hierarchical.<ref name = salvation>Pious Isamor restored dialogue: <i>"Give {{Red|all}} of yourself... for great Pharloom, for {{Red|the}} first-children who bequeath it to us... for our salva{{Red|tion}}... sure to come!"</i></ref><ref>Pious Isamor restored dialogue: <i>"See {{Red|our/the}} Citadel's simple stone, bare an{{Red|d una}}dorned. See h{{Red|ow pl}}ain our garb, how sparse o{{Red|ur}} meal. Know that... excess is sin!"</i></ref><ref>Pious Isamor [[Needolin]] dialogue: <i>"Pilgrims... all... Siblings... serving... Devout... unwavering... All... are equal..."</i></ref>

Pious Isamor originally stood in the western part of the [[Choral Chambers]], directly outside the entrance to the [[Whiteward]].<ref>[[:File:Screenshot_SS_Choral_Chambers_11.png|Screenshot]] of the oxidised statue base in the Choral Chambers.</ref> At an unknown point, it was decommissioned and left deep within the [[Whispering Vaults]].

== In-game Events ==
Pious Isamor initially appears to be an inactive, rusted statue with three [[Silk Flies]] resting on it. After playing the [[Needolin]] or inspecting the statue and attempting to leave, it awakens and recites a fragmented greeting, welcoming a "pilgrim" to the Citadel of stone and urging them to join the chorus.<ref name = stone /> If listened to again, it describes the Citadel's humble, unadorned state and warns against seeking rest or reward, demanding purity and vigilance against sin.<ref>Pious Isamor restored dialogue: <i>"{{Red|P}}ilgrim!... {{Red|C}}ast aside those many sinful hopes for rest {{Red|an}}d reward... remain pure... within our midst... {{Red|a}}sk for nothing! See {{Red|our/the}} Citadel's simple stone, bare an{{Red|d una}}dorned. See h{{Red|ow pl}}ain our garb, how sparse o{{Red|ur}} meal. Know that... excess is sin!<br>Stay vigil{{Red|ant alwa}}ys, for tho{{Red|se}} wretched pilgrims {{Red|who}} dare relen{{Red|t to}} their base desi{{Red|res}}... Left unpunish{{Red|ed (within/they thin)}} our pure chorus... {{Red|th}}eir seductive sin... {{Red|s}}pread like flame..."</i></ref> It concludes its speech by calling for total devotion to [[Pharloom]] and the first-children in the name of a promised salvation.<ref name = salvation />

== Location ==
Pious Isamor is located behind a breakable ceiling above the lower bench in the [[Whispering Vaults]].

* It is possible to [[Needle#Needle-bouncing|Needle-bounce]] on Pious Isamor.
* The large statue in the background of [[Bone Bottom]] resembles Pious Isamor.
